    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { var:oe_vas_stage ?= 2 }
}
# BYZ scope. No conquest campaign is running (gen_heg_campaigns.py: its own settlement oe_hc.110 handles that land).
oe_fs_no_campaign = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active }
}
# BYZ scope (the annexer). May open a batch now: the empire itself, calm, no campaign, no batch and no former king pending.

    tag = BYZ
    is_rebel_country = no
    oe_fs_calm = yes
    oe_fs_no_campaign = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_cur }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_k2 }
}
# Country scope (the country being annexed; design 3.2.1 and point 2). Engine probe P1 reads it through the hook.
oe_fs_target_ok = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    NOT = { tag = TUR }
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    country_rank_level >= 2
    num_locations >= 6
    NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ }
    capital ?= {
        OR = {
            AND = { has_variable = oe_theme_region var:oe_theme_region >= 2 }
            has_variable = oe_tw_former_province
        }
    }
}
# Location scope. Land of the batch the empire holds and no theme has taken over (design 3.2.2).
oe_fs_open = {

}
# Location scope. A rest location of the batch that is still open.

    oe_fs_open = yes

# BYZ scope. The events (their own triggers; trigger_event_non_silently checks them again when they fire).

# BYZ scope. Engine probe P2, the one place that reads the former ruler: the stored character still lives and is adult.

    has_variable = oe_fs_king
    var:oe_fs_king ?= { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. ... and is at the empire's court now.

# BYZ scope. The options of oe_fs.1 (design 3.2.4).

    oe_fs_auth >= oe_fs_cost_a

# Location scope. Design point 6: Orthodox or Catholic land may get a native despot, Muslim land may not.

    OR = {
        religion_percentage = { religion = religion:orthodox value >= 0.5 }
        religion_percentage = { religion = religion:catholic value >= 0.5 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The native despot's seat is not mostly Greek (option c's AI weight).
oe_fs_seat_not_greek = { var:oe_fs_seat1 ?= { culture_group_percentage = { culture_group = culture_group:greek_group value < 0.5 } } }
# BYZ scope. Engine probe P3, the self-check after the ally is built: it exists, holds the seat, is our Roman ally.
oe_fs_ally_ok = {
    exists = scope:oe_fs_ally
    scope:oe_fs_ally = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub }
    exists = scope:oe_fs_seat
